entity_raw.definition_raw:
Magical insight helps you evade attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Arcane Shield, arcane spellcaster, caster level 10th, worshiper of the god of magic or knowledge.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use Arcane Shield, you also gain a +1 insight bonus to AC for 1 round.
